notes: Left alone deliberately: content spikes[1] tells the reader to 'pop R Pop Blossom or W Shapesplitter and cross with your clone so the mark's shadow-Q lands on empty air'. Riot's text for Shapesplitter describes a clone and a move-speed passive only — nothing about invisibility or untargetability — and Death Mark repeats damage rather than firing a shadow shuriken, so I could not verify that dodge without inventing the mechanic. Flagged in unverified and in questionsForUser rather than edited. What I did add from the kit is solid: Zed is untargetable through the Death Mark dash (so nothing cast into it lands) and the mark triggers 3 seconds later. Also regraded from TRICKY/7 to EVEN/5.5 at a 53.66% win rate, and matched the full-layer chart to the content layer — the two disagreed on all seven rows, including naming opposite winners at level 6.
